card.name: Partway through suicidality warning words
card.fires_on: Responds to the middle or ending piece of a long word split into parts, mostly in the capitalized boxed warning heading about suicidal ideation (SUICID-AL, ADOLE-SC-ENTS). It also fires weakly on other split words like granules, syringes and legislature.

modes.label: Boxed suicidality heading
modes.description: Piece inside the capitalized words SUICIDAL or ADOLESCENTS in the boxed warning title.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Ending piece of a longer word split into parts, such as granules or syringes, in label or web text.
modes.example: Gran<<ules>> by Body Weight in Pediatric Patients Aged

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long words, especially the capitalized suicide-risk warning title on antidepressant-type labels.
